title: equipment-state/v1
description: What a cell is doing now. Published by the MES or an edge agent, retained at <cell path>/state/status. State, not an event: it gets no answer, and the newest timestamp wins, except for a last will (see session).

session.description: Optional: the publisher's connection (like Sparkplug's bdSeq), the same in its last will. An OFFLINE will is stamped when the publisher connected, so the ERP accepts it from the source of the current state whatever its timestamp, unless its session is not the current one (a late will of an earlier connection). Added in v0.23.1; optional, so not a new version.
